confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors rest on aggregator averages and are medium-low confidence. Beer uses shop-price pages and hotel-menu benchmarks from other cities, so it is also weak. Cocktail and wine were not found on Udaipur bar menus, so they are set relative to the beer anchor (cocktail about 2x, wine about 2.5x) as a disclosed fallback. Accommodation is a holistic model estimate; no accommodation search was run and no listings were checked. FX: the only RBA reading surfaced by search is dated 2026-03-20. I did not open the RBA table to verify it, it is not the observation for 2026-11-19, and non-RBA sources suggested a lower USD per AUD rate in November 2026.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Meal and coffee anchors follow Indian tourist-city aggregator averages for Udaipur. Beer uses Udaipur shop-price pages with hotel menus in Jaipur, Goa and New Delhi as upper benchmarks. Cocktail and wine are set relative to the beer anchor.
